column1: # Stage S11 J2e — the relocation tool leaves xtask: the `relocate` module of the `refactor` command
# group becomes the repository_relocation crate under tools/commands, flattened to the crate's src
# folder. Its module root becomes the named module of the three modes; the crate root, the prelude
# and the README files are written by hand, and the `refactor` group's command line and dispatch
# stay in the xtask binary. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the module root becomes the modes module; the folder, its README included, becomes src
# the moved code's absolute paths into its own module now start at the crate root
